source_of_truth: RUN ASC schemas + optional training doc inventory

tables.purpose: Primary plant equipment / device table: mechanical conveyors (STRAIGHT/CURVE/BELT/…), motors, photocells, beacons, and related I/O with geometry and controller ownership.
tables.row_semantics: One row per named IO_Name. Type discriminates device class (conveyor geometry vs MOTOR vs PHOTOCELL vs BEACON). Geometry fields apply to mechanical conveyors; Motor / Drive link ownership; Machine_Name scopes controller.

relationship_fields.note: Flag that motor participates in a chain

active_row_rules: IO_Name present and not placeholder (N/A, INVALID, NONE, ===…===)
Type not INVALID (supporting; mechanical conveyors use CONVEYOR_TYPES)
optional_feature_rules: NoseOver / Infeed_Tangent / Discharge_Tangent are equipment features, not topology FKs
Disable I/O / Overide I/O optional force paths
tables.controller_scope_behavior: Prefer Conveyor.asc.<CONTROLLER> overlay when present; else base Conveyor.asc. Machine_Name further filters ownership; unknown ownership does not delete the row.
generation_implications: Mechanical conveyors (CONVEYOR_TYPES) feed Transport / area PLC generation when INCLUDED
PHOTOCELL rows seed PE logic; MOTOR/VFD rows seed motor chains and drives
Geometry alone does not prove conveyor successor topology

tables.purpose: Runtime bit/force state for View I/O — live forced-on/off and bank state per I/O point.
tables.row_semantics: Indexed parallel to I/O points (not a named equipment table). Tracks Bits_On_Off, Forced_On/Off, Inverted, bank, Machine, InOut.
active_row_rules: Row slot corresponding to a configured Configio / Conveyor I/O point
inactive_row_rules: Unused bank slots with no Configio mapping
tables.controller_scope_behavior: Machine column scopes which controller owns the bit image.
generation_implications: Not a PLC generation source table; HMI/runtime diagnostic only

document_sources.title: FPC View I/O Screen and FORTNADT Table

tables.purpose: I/O point configuration map: bank/word/bit, direction, interface, and process ownership.
tables.row_semantics: One configured I/O description per Desc (or bank/word coordinate).

relationship_fields.note: Interface name ties to IOCard / adapter

inactive_row_rules: Blank Desc with no bank assignment
tables.controller_scope_behavior: May appear as Configio.asc.<CONTROLLER>; overlay wins collisions.
generation_implications: Feeds IO_MAP / module addressing when generating PLC I/O

document_sources.title: FPC View I/O Screen and FORTNADT Table

tables.purpose: Physical / logical I/O card and adapter inventory (RIO, EtherNet/IP ABS, Optomux, etc.).
tables.row_semantics: One row per named card/adapter with Type, ports, machine, and ABS network fields.
optional_feature_rules: ABS_* fields apply to EtherNet/IP adapters only
ErrorOutput / ErrorACTION / ErrorBIT optional fault signaling
tables.controller_scope_behavior: Machine column + optional overlay files scope ownership.
generation_implications: Defines adapter inventory for I/O mapping; does not invent module catalog entries

tables.purpose: Jam / start-stop zone definitions linking request flags, buttons, and StartStopZones.
tables.row_semantics: One named Zone Name owning jam latch/jammed bits and optional StartStopZone link.
active_row_rules: Zone Name present and not placeholder
tables.controller_scope_behavior: Base + optional controller overlay; Zone Owner may name owning process.
generation_implications: Jam zone membership drives area safety / jam program grouping

tables.purpose: Jam detection points: sensor PE, timer, error, conveyor, and jam zone ownership.
tables.row_semantics: One jam check per Desc/Sensor_Name linking a PE timer to Conveyor_Name and Zone.
active_row_rules: Sensor_Name or Desc present and not placeholder
Timer_Name assigned for armed jam checks
optional_feature_rules: ClearErrorWithJam / ClearJamSignal / RequireL2Reset optional clear policy
tables.controller_scope_behavior: Overlay preferred; Jam_Owner may imply process/controller.
generation_implications: Generates jam timer / PE monitoring when INCLUDED

tables.purpose: Full-jam detection: sustained full condition that escalates to jam/error response.
tables.row_semantics: Named full-jam sensor with set/clear timers, conveyor, motor-under-eye, owner.
generation_implications: Full-jam logic pairs with Fullline clear timers; INITERRORS may autogen errors

tables.purpose: Line-full / accumulation full detection with set/clear timers and response I/O.
tables.row_semantics: One full point per Desc/Sensor_Name; Clr_Timer_* used by sawtooth ReserveTM links.

relationship_fields.note: SawLane.ReserveTM often references tmfc* clear timers

generation_implications: Full PE timers feed accumulation and sawtooth reservation timing

tables.purpose: Motor startup chains: ordered downstream motors that start after a lead motor/timer.
tables.row_semantics: One chain head Motor_Name with Motor_Chained1..10 followers, aux, stop zone, heater options.
tables.controller_scope_behavior: Overlay wins; chains may cross conveyors owned by one controller.
generation_implications: Explicit RUN motor topology for startup sequencing — prefer over P-number order

tables.purpose: Start/stop zone state machine rows (request flags, owners) referenced by Jamzones.
tables.row_semantics: One Zone Name with StartReqFlag/StopReqFlag and owner controls.
active_row_rules: Zone Name present and not placeholder
tables.controller_scope_behavior: Base + overlay; owners name controlling process bits.
generation_implications: Groups conveyors into start/stop islands for area PLC

tables.purpose: E-stop device / circuit inventory (Desc/Part) with linked Error name.
tables.row_semantics: One E-stop Desc or Part entry; Error ties to Errors table when populated.

relationship_fields.note: Part may name related equipment when used

active_row_rules: Desc or Part present and not placeholder
tables.controller_scope_behavior: Present when site configures E-stop table; overlay optional.
generation_implications: E-stop zones are distinct from StartStop and Jam zones
INITERRORS may autogen related errors

tables.purpose: Carton/piece path tracking slots (Piece + PE_at/PEname). Not a static conveyor successor graph.
tables.row_semantics: Slot rows for tracked pieces. On many RUNs rows are placeholders (Piece=INVALID, Input/Output=0) — do not treat as P→P topology.

relationship_fields.note: Runtime path metrics — not static FK

generation_implications: Do not derive Transport topology from Convpath unless active named pieces exist
Physical topology remains engineer/geometry when Convpath unpopulated

tables.purpose: Classic sawtooth merge lane configuration (PE, reserve timing, EOW, merge parent).
tables.row_semantics: One named lane linked to SawMerge with PhotoEyeIO, ReserveTM, slice timing, EOW I/O.

relationship_fields.note: Often tmfc* clear timer from Fullline

generation_implications: Active SawLane+SawMerge → sawtooth_merges discovery; library path still feature-gated

tables.purpose: Classic sawtooth merge collector / boss (motor, reservation input, slice timing).
tables.row_semantics: One named merge with MotorIO, ReserveIN, LaneEnableDelayTM, live slice status.

relationship_fields.note: Sorter name may match merge process

active_row_rules: MotorIO or ReserveIN assigned for active merges
generation_implications: Collector motor/enable path for sawtooth PLC when generation supported

tables.purpose: High-speed sawtooth lane FSM: slow/fast/accum I/O, LanePE, opportunistic feed, offsets.
tables.row_semantics: Named HS lane under HSSawMerge/SawMerge with LanePE and speed action bits.
active_row_rules: Enabled when site uses HS module
tables.controller_scope_behavior: Often empty of active named rows even when table present.
generation_implications: HS path is optional upgrade over classic SawLane; only use when active rows exist

tables.purpose: High-speed sawtooth merge boss: reservation creation, induct, encoder mode, control machine.
tables.row_semantics: Named HS merge with MergeRunIO, MergeInduct, TimeBasedEncoder, ControlMachine.
generation_implications: When active, upgrades sawtooth model beyond classic SawMerge fields

tables.purpose: Per-lane HS parameters: reservation inches/spacing, slug gap, priority, speed, enable.
tables.row_semantics: Parameter set named and linked to SawLane.
generation_implications: Parameter source for HS reservation geometry

tables.purpose: Lookup vocabulary for HS lane FSM state display names.
tables.row_semantics: One Name per state label (e.g. Stopped, Wait PE On, Feed Slow).
generation_implications: Display/state labels only — not control logic source

tables.purpose: HS sawtooth simulation rows (create boxes, length/gap, force PE).
tables.row_semantics: Named sim profile linked to SawLane.
generation_implications: Simulation aid — not production PLC generation input

tables.purpose: Legacy multi-induct merge table (Presence/Release/Priority/timers per induct 1..5).
tables.row_semantics: One Merge Table Name with up to five induct columns.
tables.controller_scope_behavior: May be unused when MergeBoss/SimpleMerge preferred.
generation_implications: Legacy; prefer MergeBoss/Inputs/Route when present

tables.purpose: Two-way simple merge: mainline vs lane presence/run with clear timer.
tables.row_semantics: Named simple merge with MainLineRun, LaneRun, presence eyes, Machine.
generation_implications: Simple merge PLC pattern when INCLUDED

tables.purpose: Multi-input merge boss: owns inputs count, operable input, switch delay.
tables.row_semantics: Named boss; MergeInputs rows reference MergeBoss name.
generation_implications: Parent of MergeInputs/Route graph

tables.purpose: Per-input lane under a MergeBoss: presence, release I/O, timers, MergeRoute link.
tables.row_semantics: Named input with MergeBoss FK and optional MergeRoute.
generation_implications: Lane arbitration inputs for multi-merge

tables.purpose: Merge route binding inputs to outputs with busy/request/priority.
tables.row_semantics: Named route linking MergeInputs and MergeOutputs signals.
generation_implications: Route enable graph for multi-merge

tables.purpose: Zipper merge boss: turn-based reservation, merge motor, speed, induct.
tables.row_semantics: Named zipper merge with MergeMtr, MergeInduct, MergeRunIO, ControlMachine.
generation_implications: Distinct from sawtooth; only generate when Zipper* rows active

tables.purpose: Zipper lane under ZipperMerge: turns, reservation lengths, meter/pre speeds, accum I/O.
tables.row_semantics: Named lane with ZipperMerge FK and extensive meter/merge parameters.
generation_implications: Lane parameters for zipper merge generation

tables.purpose: Sorter entity definition: encoder binding, shift buffers, divert enable, machine.
tables.row_semantics: One Sorter Name with Encoder ioName/tmName and record-range cursors into track tables.
active_row_rules: Sorter Name present and not placeholder
generation_implications: Discovery-only until complete generic sorter library path exists
Tracking/WCS generation NOT_SUPPORTED by policy

tables.purpose: Application sorter control: motor status, host msg tables, scan/data error signaling.
tables.row_semantics: Named app sorter control with ControlMachine and message table bindings.
optional_feature_rules: Second* msg tables optional tandem scanners
generation_implications: App control skeleton for sorter discovery

tables.purpose: Scan zone boss: links AppSorter, ScanZone, update points, lane assignment hooks.
tables.row_semantics: Named scan boss under an AppSorter with scan error/conflict handling.
generation_implications: Scan assignment points — not divert IO map

tables.purpose: Host zone → sorter lane assignment with full-clear timer and enable signals.
tables.row_semantics: Named zone-lane row under AppSorter with HostZone and Lane.
generation_implications: Static lane assignment; divert IO still engineer-required

tables.purpose: Runtime carton tracking slot tables SrtTrack1..5 — confirm scan, host zone, sorter lane, dimensions. Not static topology.
tables.row_semantics: Named-slot or indexed carton records with ConfirmScan, ScanZoneID, SorterLane, SrtAppRec. Numeric empty slots are inactive.
active_row_rules: ConfirmScan / HostZone / ScanZoneID evidence of live track slot
tables.controller_scope_behavior: Shared runtime menus; sized per sorter docs.
generation_implications: Proves tracking activity; does NOT define divert output maps
classification=RUNTIME_DATA

tables.purpose: Transfer tracking runtime slots (scan confirm, route boss/table rec, XfrZoneID).
tables.row_semantics: Parallel to SrtTrack for transfer path; RouteBossRec / RouteTableRec runtime links.
generation_implications: RUNTIME_DATA — transfer divert maps still engineer/config

tables.purpose: Transfer route table: host route string → Route under a BossRecord.
tables.row_semantics: Named route row with Enabled, BossRecord, HostRouteStr, error I/O.
generation_implications: Static transfer routes — still not full divert PLC map

tables.purpose: Transfer route boss: scan zone, msg tables, conveyor motor, error signaling.
tables.row_semantics: Named boss controlling transfer scan/route decisioning.
generation_implications: Transfer discovery skeleton

tables.purpose: Communications endpoint inventory: controllers, hosts, scanners, protocols, ports.
tables.row_semantics: One Machine_Name with Connection_Type, Communication_Protocol, Machine_Port, Offline.
active_row_rules: Offline not asserted for live endpoints
tables.controller_scope_behavior: Machine table lists all peers; controller overlays on other tables filter by Machine_Name.
generation_implications: Defines peer inventory; TCP endpoints for WCS still may be engineer-required

tables.purpose: Message map: binds Message_Name to Machine_Name, msg types, and Menu_Name queues.
tables.row_semantics: One Message_Name routing recv/send/ack types to a menu (e.g. MsgWCS).
generation_implications: Comm routing skeleton; not full WCS PLC

tables.purpose: Tracking message outbound/inbound queue (runtime). Often empty on RUNs.
tables.row_semantics: Queue rows for tracking messages when the file is populated.
active_row_rules: Non-empty message payload / destination when file has schema
tables.controller_scope_behavior: Runtime queue; may be zero-byte on archive.
generation_implications: RUNTIME_DATA; absence is normal
tables.schema_note: Header unavailable (empty or missing ASC). Semantics from docs/catalog only; no invented fields claimed as RUN-present.

tables.purpose: WCS outbound message queue: MsgText + Destination topic + tx status.
tables.row_semantics: Queue slots; Destination topic (/topic/…) counts as active even when MsgText blank.
active_row_rules: Destination present (topic path) OR MsgText present
tables.controller_scope_behavior: Shared queue; MsgMap selects owning machine.
generation_implications: Proves WCS messaging activity; TCP peer still configuration
RUNTIME_DATA classification

tables.purpose: Static WCS/NMS event → destination/category/service enable map.
tables.row_semantics: One EventName with WCSEnable/WCSDestination and optional NMS fields.
tables.controller_scope_behavior: Usually base shared; enable flags select live events.
generation_implications: Static event catalog for WCS interface discovery

tables.purpose: Sorter/merge encoder devices: ticks/ft, target FPM, enable bit, jamzone.
tables.row_semantics: One Encoder Name with Encoder I/O, timing, speed limits, EnableBit, Jamzone.
active_row_rules: Encoder Name present and not placeholder
generation_implications: Encoder scale/speed seeds for sorter/sawtooth when generation supported
